messages:
Nina: Heads-up 1: Silica Nanite EAP NDA signed today. Can we confirm test board arrival window and stub drivers?
Silica-poc: Hi all 1: Boards shipment slated for 2026-04-12. We'll host the driver and a reference container on our portal: https://partners.silica/nanite/eap.
Reza: Awesome. Legal flagged microcode & firmware blobs as restricted. Legal-bot, did you append the allowed telemetry list?
legal-bot: NDA signed. Allowed telemetry: perf counters, memory usage, driver errors. Forbidden: microcode dumps, proprietary trace logs. See comments in doc.
Kevin: For benchmark plan 1: propose three runs: latency sweep (seq 32/128/512), throughput steady-state (batch sweep), and quantized run (int4 candidate). We should also capture GPU power draw.
Infra-Jude: Need the exact run commands to bake into autoscaling job. Also request for a golden container image (sha256).
Dev-bot: Autoscaler job template created: `k8s/autoscale-nanite.yaml`. Replace IMAGE_SHA with partner artifact.
Reza: Example commands (local harness):
```
python bench.py --model rwd-v1-13b --seq 512 --batch 4 --mode latency --out s3://bench/silica/1841002468/latency
python bench.py --model rwd-v1-13b --seq 1024 --batch 32 --mode throughput --out s3://bench/silica/1841002468/throughput
python bench.py --model rwd-v1-13b --seq 1024 --batch 32 --mode quant --quant int4 --out s3://bench/silica/1841002468/quant
```
Kevin: Please add `--power-sample` and `--pci-counters` flags to capture hw metrics.
Silica-poc: We'll provide power sensor access and a small helper script to normalize wattage readings.
Nina: Reminder: scrub logs for any firmware traces before uploading. Use `--strip-firmware` in the harness.
Reza: Will add `--strip-firmware` and a post-process step that runs `scrub_logs.py` before s3 put.
Bench-bot: Bench run kicked off on infra-gpu-7. Est. 2.5h. Artifacts -> s3://bench/silica/1841002468/runmeta.json
Bench-bot: Latency sweep complete. Summary: seq32 p50=2.9ms/token p99=9.1ms/token; seq512 p50=11.8ms/token p99=42.3ms/token. Throughput run: 2350 tok/s (steady). Power avg=412W. Quant run queued. Full artifacts: s3://bench/silica/1841002468/results.tar.gz
Kevin: Those numbers look promising. Please stash raw perf CSVs for the partner report.
Nina: Legal needs the scrubbed report by EOD Friday for partner sharing. Reza, can you own that?
Reza: On it. I'll produce two variants: internal (full counters) and partner copy (scrubbed).
Silica-poc: We'll review the partner copy and sign the acknowledgment. Also planning a joint blog preview 1: hold until we have partner-approved numbers + marketing sign-off.
Nina: Blockers?
Infra-Jude: One: network egress rules for the boards are restrictive, need exception to upload to S3. Two: firmware update requires a secure console which Silica will provide creds for.
Silica-poc: We'll open a support ticket with your infra team and share one-time creds via vault.
Nina: Great. Action list: (1) Reza produces scrubbed partner report, (2) Infra-Jude sets egress workflow, (3) Silica uploads driver/container and power helper, (4) Marketing sync once partner sign-off. Quick check-in Thu 10am PT.
Kevin: Adding a note: include SOC temperature profiles; partner cares about thermal throttling.
Reza: Noted. Will include temp logs and throttling events in internal report only.
Nina: Thanks everyone. Drop any quick updates here. :rocket:
